deadline.value: The Fall deadline is February 15, 2027, but the department says plain admission has no deadline. F-1 applicants cannot be admitted yet.
deadline.quote: Application deadline for Fall semester is February 15th

also.quote: Loyola University Chicago is currently awaiting approval from the Department of Homeland Security to issue I-20s to international students for this program
Until then, we cannot issue Form I-20s specifically for this program

app_fee.value: There is no fee to apply to the CS PhD.
app_fee.quote: There is no fee to apply for the PhD in Computer Science

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is decided on the applicant's portfolio, not on a named faculty supervisor's agreement.
supervisor.quote: Admission will be based on strength of applicant, evidenced in a portfolio comprising an essay

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are funded as teaching or research assistants for the whole program, with a monthly stipend and tuition remission.
funding.quote: All CS PhD students are funded either as teaching assistants or research assistants by the department for the duration of their program | Funding includes a monthly stipend and tuition remission

entry_route.value: The CS PhD pages do not say whether a master's is needed or whether a bachelor's alone is enough.

notes: Important: Loyola says it is awaiting DHS approval to issue I-20s for this PhD. Until approved, F-1 international applicants cannot be admitted. The International Applicant Requirements page applies to all others.
